ValidationRule.description: Carrier-specific tracking formats (CASE ladder), handling vs service level rules, customs code shape for international shipments and declared-value insurance rules.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c)), OR( CASE(TEXT(Carrier__c), 'UPS', IF(AND(BEGINS(Tracking_Number__c, '1Z'), LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 18), 0, 1), 'FedEx', IF(OR(LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 12, LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 15), 0, 1), 'DHL', IF(AND(LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 10, ISNUMBER(Tracking_Number__c)), 0, 1), 0) = 1, Tracking_Number__c <> UPPER(Tracking_Number__c), CONTAINS(Tracking_Number__c, ' ') ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Handling__c)), OR( AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Hazmat'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Air'), ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Express'))), AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Refrigerated'), CASE(TEXT(Service_Level__c), 'Air', 0, 'Express', 0, 1) = 1), AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Oversized'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Freight'))), PICKLISTCOUNT(Handling__c) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), 2, 4) ) ), IF( Is_International__c, OR( ISBLANK(Customs_Code__c), NOT(REGEX(BLANKVALUE(Customs_Code__c, 'x'), 'HS-[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{2}')), LPAD(RIGHT(BLANKVALUE(Customs_Code__c, '00'), 2), 3, '0') = RPAD('0', 3, '0') ), NOT(ISBLANK(Customs_Code__c)) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Declared_Value__c)), NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) > 0, OR( Declared_Value__c / Weight_Kg__c > 1000 * SQRT(Weight_Kg__c), AND(Declared_Value__c >= 5000, NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required'))) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tracking number, handling instructions, customs code or declared value conflict with the shipment's carrier/service.
